rationale: The instance metadata service hands out the credentials of the notebook's IAM role, and under IMDSv1 it hands them to any request that reaches the link-local address, with no token and no proof of intent. A notebook is an environment where third-party code runs by design - a library installed from a cell, a notebook shared as a file, a model or dataset downloaded to inspect - and every one of those is a way for a single unauthenticated GET to walk out with the role's credentials. IMDSv2 requires a PUT to obtain a token first, which the classes of request that reach the metadata service by accident cannot make.
remediation: Set the minimum instance metadata service version of the notebook instance to 2, which can be changed on an existing notebook after stopping it; a notebook on an older platform identifier has to be recreated on a current one first
